Democrats Sue Trump Administration Over Voter Roll Purges

Democrats filed a lawsuit on Tuesday in Washington against former President Trump and his administration, alleging an effort to usurp states' authority to administer elections by purging voter rolls ahead of the midterms. The lawsuit was also filed against the US Justice Department. Separately, reports indicate that US and Israel are preparing plans for renewed Iran strikes, focusing on short, intense attacks. In Israel, AI is shaping the election campaign, where Arab voters could hold a key to Netanyahu's future. Meanwhile, a poll found Democrats are souring on mail-in voting amid Trump's attacks, and Trump's approval rating has fallen to 36%.
